evidence.text: A system's behavior emerges from the relationships among its parts.
Exact matching can recover a timestamp without changing the source text.

core_insights.insight: System-level behavior cannot be inferred from isolated component scores alone.
core_insights.why_it_matters: Teams can otherwise optimize parts while degrading the assembled system.
core_insights.generalization: Evaluate interactions wherever behavior emerges from composition.

deep_dives.research_question: Which scenarios expose interaction failures most reliably?
deep_dives.why: Component metrics can hide coordination problems.

article_ideas.title: The system is the unit of evaluation
article_ideas.thesis: Interaction outcomes deserve their own evaluation layer.
article_ideas.angle: Show how local optimization misses system failures.

project_ideas.name: Interaction Failure Atlas
project_ideas.hypothesis: A scenario library will reveal recurring coordination failures.
project_ideas.poc: Build a small corpus of multi-component evaluation scenarios.
project_ideas.measurement: Count failures found only by scenario-level tests.

architectural_implications.observation: Interactions can dominate individual component quality.
architectural_implications.consequence: Architecture reviews must include system-level scenarios.

tradeoffs_and_failure_modes.benefit: Component tests are fast and easy to isolate.
tradeoffs_and_failure_modes.cost_or_risk: They may miss failures caused by interactions.

open_questions.question: How much scenario coverage is enough?
open_questions.why_unresolved: Interaction spaces grow faster than test budgets.
open_questions.research_direction: Compare coverage heuristics against discovered failures.

key_claims.claim: System-level evaluation finds classes of failures that isolated evaluation misses.
key_claims.verification_question: Can a benchmark quantify the gap across representative workflows?

key_claims.claim: Exact source matching is safer than guessing missing evidence timing.

connections.relationship: Both evaluate behavior produced by interactions.
